question: How often must regulators in a region excused from the quarter-hour interval weigh costs against benefits of aligning it?
reply: {"gold_answers": "yes", "gold_reason": "Article 53(3) of Regulation 2017/2195 says that where the regulatory authorities of a synchronous area grant an exemption from the 15-minute imbalance settlement period, they must perform a cost-benefit analysis on harmonising the period at least every three years, in cooperation with the Agency.", "other_articles": [], "ambiguity": "minor", "ambiguity_reason": "The question uses obfuscated wording (\"quarter-hour interval\", \"the Agency\" implied), but it maps clearly to the imbalance settlement period exemption in Art 53(3). Art 8(4) of Reg 2019/943 covers the same derogation but contains no cost-benefit review frequency.", "suggested_fix": ""}

verdict.gold_reason: Article 53(3) of Regulation 2017/2195 says that where the regulatory authorities of a synchronous area grant an exemption from the 15-minute imbalance settlement period, they must perform a cost-benefit analysis on harmonising the period at least every three years, in cooperation with the Agency.
verdict.ambiguity_reason: The question uses obfuscated wording ("quarter-hour interval", "the Agency" implied), but it maps clearly to the imbalance settlement period exemption in Art 53(3). Art 8(4) of Reg 2019/943 covers the same derogation but contains no cost-benefit review frequency.
